scope.documents: SysML 2.0 Part 1: Language and KerML 1.0, including their normative abstract-syntax XMI, ten library archives and three JSON schemas.
scope.currentProduct: Read-only textual model analysis and structural viewing with a reusable kernel.
scope.longTermTarget: Qualify the complete language kernel; decide editing, normative interchange, execution and graphical tool-conformance claims separately.
scope.sourcePrecedence: Clause 2 in each specification gives its normative machine-readable files precedence if they conflict with the PDF.
scope.denominator: Source units overlap: clauses contain productions, constraints and prose candidates. Their counts cannot be added into a requirements-coverage denominator.
scope.closure: An individual requirement can be qualified only after its obligations are decomposed, applicable cases and boundaries are reviewed, implementation/API evidence is current, and linked positive/negative checks pass. Parent clauses never inherit a passing status from a child.

graph.role: candidate upstream graph and resolution implementation; presence does not prove every rule

diagram.role: current structural overview; not complete normative graphical notation
